items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Diddy and Shelley were the two trumpet players. ... Diddy and Euless John. ... That was one of the trumpet players.

ctx.x: Were they all there at once, or did they have two, or how did that work? No.
No. No. Diddy and Shelley were the two trumpet players. Yeah. They were two trumpet players.
